sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:36055
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11548 of 2022

Applicant :- Indrasen Alias Karkau
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy . Home And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar Shukla,Ajey Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Ajey Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, learned A.G.A. for
the State and perused the records.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
254 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Visheshvarganj,
District Bahraich.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 16.07.2022 alleging that the informant's daughter aged about 13 years had gone missing at about 04:00 am on 13.07.2022.
4.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she stated that she is aged 16 years, she knows the applicant for the past one year and she had gone on her own to Gonda and thereafter she went to the applicant and started living with him as his wife.

5. In the medico legal examination of the victim, no mark of injury or sign of use of force has been reported.
6. The radiological examination of the victim has not been conducted for ascertaining her age.
7. Before the Magistrate also the victim gave a similar statement, as was given by her before the Investigating Officer.

8. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

9. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
10.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the victim has consistently stated that she has gone with the applicant out of her own free will and no sign of use of force or mark of injury has been found on any part of the victim's body,
coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 30.07.2022 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
11. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 Pradeep/-
